name: cc-doc-review
description: Review Claude-generated Markdown/HTML in a browser panel: select text, comment, and send the comments back to the Claude Code session.

autoRegister.title: Auto-register documents for review
autoRegister.description: Register a document for review automatically after Claude writes a file that matches the include patterns. When off, open documents manually with /cc-doc-review or by asking Claude to call review_open.

includePatterns.title: Auto-register: include patterns
includePatterns.description: Comma-separated glob patterns matched against the path relative to the session working directory (supports **, *, ?, {a,b}; case-insensitive; at most 8 wildcards per pattern). Empty disables auto-registration.

excludePatterns.title: Auto-register: exclude patterns
excludePatterns.description: Comma-separated glob patterns. A match is never auto-registered; exclude wins over include.
